prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-20.8s) - Basic definition
title = Text("Arithmetic Progression (AP)", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
definition = Text("A sequence where each term is obtained by\nadding a fixed number to the previous term",
                 font_size=36, line_spacing=1.5).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)

numbers = VGroup(
    *[Text(str(2 + 3*i), font_size=40) for i in range(5)]
).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1)
numbers.next_to(definition, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(definition), run_time=4)
self.wait(2)
self.play(FadeIn(numbers, shift=UP), run_time=3)
self.wait(8.8)  # Complete 20.8s segment

# Segment 2 (20.8-37.6s) - Common difference
common_diff_text = Text("Common Difference (d)", color=YELLOW, font_size=40)
common_diff_text.next_to(numbers, DOWN, buff=1.5)

arrows = VGroup()
for i in range(len(numbers)-1):
    arrow = Arrow(
        numbers[i].get_bottom(),
        numbers[i+1].get_bottom(),
        color=YELLOW,
        buff=0.2
    ).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
    arrows.add(arrow)

plus_threes = VGroup()
for i in range(len(arrows)):
    plus_three = MathTex("+3", color=YELLOW, font_size=36)
    plus_three.next_to(arrows[i], DOWN, buff=0.1)
    plus_threes.add(plus_three)

self.play(Write(common_diff_text), run_time=3)
self.play(
    *[GrowArrow(arrow) for arrow in arrows],
    run_time=4
)
self.play(
    *[Write(plus) for plus in plus_threes],
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(6.8)  # Complete 16.8s segment

# Segment 3 (37.6-59.9s) - Calculating common difference
calc_text = VGroup(
    Text("d = any term - previous term", font_size=36),
    Text("d = 5 - 2 = 3", font_size=36),
    Text("d = 8 - 5 = 3", font_size=36),
    Text("d = 11 - 8 = 3", font_size=36)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3)
calc_text.next_to(plus_threes, DOWN, buff=1)

for i, text in enumerate(calc_text):
    self.play(Write(text), run_time=3)
    self.wait(2.575)  # (22.3 - 4*3) / 4 = 2.575s per iteration

# Segment 4 (59.9-83.8s) - General form
general_form = VGroup(
    MathTex("a", ", "),
    MathTex("a+d", ", "),
    MathTex("a+2d", ", "),
    MathTex("a+3d", ", "),
    MathTex("a+4d", ", "),
    MathTex(r"\cdots")
).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
general_form.next_to(calc_text, DOWN, buff=1)

general_title = Text("General Form:", font_size=36)
general_title.next_to(general_form, UP)

self.play(
    Write(general_title),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    *[Write(term) for term in general_form],
    run_time=8
)

explanation = Text("where 'a' is first term and 'd' is common difference",
                  font_size=32)
explanation.next_to(general_form, DOWN)

self.play(Write(explanation), run_time=5)
self.wait(7.9)  # Complete 23.9s segment

section_title: The Nth Term of an AP
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-29.4s) - Formula introduction
title = Text("The nth Term of an Arithmetic Progression", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
formula = MathTex(r"a_n = a + (n-1)d").scale(1.5)
formula_parts = VGroup(
    Text("where:", font_size=32),
    MathTex(r"a_n", r"\text{ is the nth term}"),
    MathTex(r"a", r"\text{ is the first term}"),
    MathTex(r"d", r"\text{ is the common difference}"),
    MathTex(r"n", r"\text{ is the position number}")
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).next_to(formula, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(formula), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(formula_parts[0]), run_time=1)
for part in formula_parts[1:]:
    self.play(Write(part), run_time=2)
self.wait(11.4)

# Segment 2 (29.4-49.8s) - Example setup
example = Text("Example: Find the 10th term of AP: 2, 7, 12, ...", font_size=36)
given = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"a = 2"),
    MathTex(r"d = 7 - 2 = 5"),
    MathTex(r"n = 10")
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(formula_parts),
    formula.animate.scale(0.7).to_edge(UP),
    FadeOut(title),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(example.next_to(formula, DOWN, buff=0.5)), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(given.next_to(example, DOWN, buff=0.5)), run_time=3)
self.wait(13.3)

# Segment 3 (49.8-67.5s) - Solution walkthrough
solution = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"a_{10} = 2 + (10-1)5"),
    MathTex(r"= 2 + (9)5"),
    MathTex(r"= 2 + 45"),
    MathTex(r"= 47")
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).next_to(given, DOWN, buff=0.5)

for step in solution:
    self.play(Write(step), run_time=2)
self.play(
    Circumscribe(solution[-1], color=YELLOW),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(7.8)

# Segment 4 (67.5-96.5s) - Backwards example
new_example = VGroup(
    Text("Example: Which term of AP: 21, 18, 15, ... is -81?", font_size=36),
    MathTex(r"a = 21, d = -3"),
    MathTex(r"-81 = 21 + (n-1)(-3)"),
    MathTex(r"-81 = 21 - 3n + 3"),
    MathTex(r"-105 = -3n"),
    MathTex(r"n = 35")
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(example),
    FadeOut(given),
    FadeOut(solution),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(new_example[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(new_example[1]), run_time=2)
for step in new_example[2:]:
    self.play(Write(step), run_time=3)
self.play(
    Circumscribe(new_example[-1], color=YELLOW),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(7.9)

section_title: Sum of First n Terms of an AP
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-34.0s) - Introducing sum formula
title = Text("Sum of First n Terms of an AP", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
formula1 = MathTex(
    "S_n = \\frac{n}{2}[2a + (n-1)d]",
    font_size=48
).shift(UP)

explanation = VGroup(
    Text("where:", font_size=32),
    MathTex("S_n", "=", "\\text{sum of first n terms}"),
    MathTex("a", "=", "\\text{first term}"),
    MathTex("d", "=", "\\text{common difference}"),
    MathTex("n", "=", "\\text{number of terms}")
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).shift(DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(formula1), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(
    *[Write(item) for item in explanation],
    lag_ratio=0.5,
    run_time=5
)
self.wait(20)

# Segment 2 (34.0-55.9s) - Alternative formula with last term
formula2 = MathTex(
    "S_n = \\frac{n}{2}(a + l)",
    font_size=48
).shift(UP)
last_term = MathTex(
    "l = \\text{last term}",
    font_size=36
).next_to(explanation, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(formula1, formula2),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Write(last_term), run_time=2)
self.wait(16.8)

# Segment 3 (55.9-85.3s) - Example calculation
example_title = Text("Example: Sum of first 22 terms", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
example_ap = MathTex(
    "8, 3, -2, ...",
    font_size=40
).shift(UP)
calculation = VGroup(
    MathTex("a = 8"),
    MathTex("d = -5"),
    MathTex("n = 22")
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).shift(LEFT * 2)

solution = VGroup(
    MathTex("S_{22} = \\frac{22}{2}[2(8) + (22-1)(-5)]"),
    MathTex("= 11[16 - 105]"),
    MathTex("= 11(-89)"),
    MathTex("= -979")
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).shift(RIGHT * 2)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(title, example_title),
    FadeOut(VGroup(formula2, explanation, last_term)),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(example_ap), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(calculation), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(
    *[Write(item) for item in solution],
    lag_ratio=0.5,
    run_time=5
)
self.wait(15.4)

# Segment 1 (0-20.8s) - Spiral with increasing semicircles
axes = Axes(x_range=[-6, 6], y_range=[-4, 4])
center_a = np.array([-1, 0, 0])
center_b = np.array([1, 0, 0])

# Create semicircles with increasing radii
semicircles = VGroup()
for i in range(8):
    radius = 0.5 * (i + 1)
    if i % 2 == 0:
        arc = Arc(radius=radius, angle=PI, start_angle=0, 
                 arc_center=center_a, color=BLUE)
    else:
        arc = Arc(radius=radius, angle=PI, start_angle=PI,
                 arc_center=center_b, color=BLUE)
    semicircles.add(arc)

title = Text("Arithmetic Progressions in Real Life", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
radius_label = MathTex(r"r = 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, ...", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Create(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(axes), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(radius_label), run_time=2)
for arc in semicircles:
    self.play(Create(arc), run_time=1.5)
self.wait(4.8)  # Complete 20.8s segment

# Segment 2 (20.8-33.0s) - Show length calculation
length_formula = MathTex(
    r"S_{13} = \frac{13}{2}({\pi} + \frac{13\pi}{2}) = 143\text{ cm}",
    font_size=36
).next_to(radius_label, DOWN)
self.play(Write(length_formula), run_time=4)
self.play(Indicate(length_formula, color=YELLOW), run_time=4)
self.wait(4.2)  # Complete 12.2s segment

# Segment 3 (33.0-55.9s) - Log stack visualization
self.play(
    *[FadeOut(obj) for obj in [semicircles, axes, radius_label, length_formula]],
    run_time=2
)

# Create log stack visualization
logs = VGroup()
y_offset = -3
for row in range(5):  # Simplified to 5 rows for clarity
    logs_in_row = 20 - row
    row_group = VGroup()
    for i in range(logs_in_row):
        log = Rectangle(height=0.3, width=0.8, color=GOLD)
        log.shift(RIGHT * i * 0.9 + UP * row * 0.35 + UP * y_offset)
        row_group.add(log)
    logs.add(row_group)

stack_label = Text("Stack of 200 logs", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
ap_label = MathTex(r"20, 19, 18, ...", font_size=32).next_to(stack_label, DOWN)

self.play(Create(logs[0]), run_time=3)
for i in range(1, len(logs)):
    self.play(Create(logs[i]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(stack_label), Write(ap_label), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.9)  # Complete 22.9s segment

# Segment 4 (55.9-61.4s) - Show equation solution
solution = MathTex(r"n = 16\text{ rows}", font_size=36).next_to(ap_label, DOWN)
self.play(Write(solution), run_time=3)
self.wait(2.6)  # Complete 5.6s segment

# Segment 5 (61.4-81.2s) - Potato race visualization
self.play(
    *[FadeOut(obj) for obj in [logs, stack_label, ap_label, solution]],
    run_time=2
)

# Create potato race track
track = Line(LEFT * 5, RIGHT * 5, color=WHITE)
bucket = Square(side_length=0.5, color=BLUE).move_to(LEFT * 5)
potatoes = VGroup(*[
    Circle(radius=0.2, color=BROWN).move_to(LEFT * 5 + RIGHT * (3 * i + 5))
    for i in range(4)
])

race_label = Text("Potato Race", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
distance_label = MathTex(r"5m, 8m, 11m, ...", font_size=32).next_to(race_label, DOWN)

self.play(Create(track), Create(bucket), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(potatoes), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(race_label), Write(distance_label), run_time=3)
self.wait(8.8)  # Complete 19.8s segment

# Segment 6 (81.2-93.4s) - Show total distance
total_distance = MathTex(
    r"S_{10} = 370\text{ meters}", font_size=36
).next_to(distance_label, DOWN)
self.play(Write(total_distance), run_time=4)
self.play(Indicate(total_distance, color=YELLOW), run_time=4)
self.wait(4.2)  # Complete 12.2s segment

# Segment 1 (0-12.7s) - Introducing first example
title = Text("Worked Examples", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
example5 = Text("Example 5:", font_size=36).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)
problem5 = MathTex(r"\text{Determine the AP whose 3rd term is 5}\\", r"\text{and the 7th term is 9}").next_to(example5, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(example5), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(problem5), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 2 (12.7-35.5s) - Solving first example
equations = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"a + 2d = 5", r"\quad \text{(3rd term)}"),
    MathTex(r"a + 6d = 9", r"\quad \text{(7th term)}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(problem5, DOWN, buff=1)

solution = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\text{Solving simultaneously:}"),
    MathTex(r"d = 1"),
    MathTex(r"a = 3")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(equations, DOWN, buff=1)

ap_terms = MathTex(r"\text{AP: }3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, \ldots").next_to(solution, DOWN)

self.play(Write(equations[0]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(equations[1]), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(solution[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(solution[1]), Write(solution[2]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(ap_terms), run_time=3)
self.wait(6.9)

# Segment 3 (35.5-49.2s) - Introducing second example
self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(equations, solution, ap_terms)), run_time=2)

example7 = Text("Example 7:", font_size=36).next_to(problem5, DOWN, buff=1)
problem7 = MathTex(r"\text{How many two-digit numbers}\\", r"\text{are divisible by 3?}").next_to(example7, DOWN)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(example5, example7),
    ReplacementTransform(problem5, problem7),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 4 (49.2-65.0s) - Solving second example
ap_info = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\text{AP: }12, 15, 18, \ldots, 99"),
    MathTex(r"a = 12, \quad d = 3, \quad a_n = 99")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(problem7, DOWN, buff=1)

solution7 = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"99 = 12 + (n-1)3"),
    MathTex(r"n = 30 \text{ numbers}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(ap_info, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(ap_info[0]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(ap_info[1]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(solution7), run_time=3)
self.wait(6.7)
